ReleaseIndexEntry.description:
One installable release of the index's target: what the release's
`ota-manifest.json` says about its identity and what it needs, and when
it was published.

publishedAt.description:
When the release was published (RFC 3339, UTC), as GitHub reports
it. For display only: the version, not this, is the release's order.

requires.description: What a board must have to take the release without USB.

version.description: The release version (`2026.10.06-19`); never a dev version.

wireProto.description: The device wire protocol version the release speaks.

Requires.description:
What a board must have to take a build over the air. Only a prediction:
the board decides.

layout.description:
The flash layout; the board's must be **equal** (M4's code table:
`1` = layout 1).

loader.description:
The loader version; the board's must be **≥** this (M4's code table:
`1` = M2's loader, `0` = no version word).

description: The firmware release index, format 1 (lpc_firmware_release::ReleaseIndex), served at /api/v1/firmware/<target>/releases: the releases one target can install, newest first by numeric version order. Readers refuse another format and ignore unknown fields; an additive optional field keeps format 1. See the firmware-distribution ADR.

releases.description: The installable releases, newest first (numeric version order).

target.description: The target every entry is a build of (`esp32c6-4mb`); opaque.

title: firmware release index
